state:
Goal `tools-cli`: four features of `docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md` now have all their proofs:
`files-extensions-and-tags`, `nvs-api-diff`, `nvs-ast` and `nvs-meta-json`. The `nvs ast` and
`nvs meta --json` sections now each show a fenced example, and the meta section now documents the
`[entry.nvs]` form and its `program` key (`rule:tooling/meta-json-takes-a-program`). Neither proof
found a bug in the binary. `bun nv proofs --owed | grep tools:cli` lists the nine features still
owed. Four of them also owe `help`, because their section has no fenced block: `nvs-build-compile`,
`nvs-build-openapi`, `nvs-info` and `the-compile-cache`.

items.text: **`tools:cli/nvs-info`** — owes examples, help, hostile, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md:333`. For help, add a fenced `text` block with real `nvs info` output, trimmed. Before writing a new test, look for an existing `nvs info` test in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/` that only needs a `// covers: tools:cli/nvs-info` marker.

**`tools:cli/the-compile-cache`** — owes examples, help, hostile, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md:406`. For help, add a fenced `toml` or `text` block showing `[opcache] file_cache_dir`.

backlog: `tools:cli/one-binary`, `nvs-run`, `nvs-check`, `nvs-test` and `nvs-config-check-and-nvs-config-dump` owe examples, hostile and tests only. Most already have Rust tests that need only a `covers:` marker.

A flat chain of about 91 `.` or `+` operators is refused with `E0108`. The bound is deliberate (`crates/nvs-syntax/src/parser/expr.rs:81` `parse_left_assoc`'s doc comment). PHP accepts any length, so a long generated concatenation will fail to compile.
The meta attack drops `@example`: a tag naming a file under `tests/hostile/` gets `E0325` even though the file is under `tests/`. Not checked whether that is intended.
